page.overview:
Who is Renelle Talbert?

Renelle is a small preteen with curly black hair, dark brown eyes, and pink-tinged skin.

When Renelle was little, she was constantly sick. She went in and out of the hospital a lot, and Dr. Talbert was scared for her life. She studies the substance of Remnant, creating a heart shaped pendant as a gift for her. Eventually, she conquered her illness and could live a normal life.

According to Eleanor, two years prior to the events of the epilogues, Renelle's mom passed away. Both she and her father were in grief, but became distant to one another. Dr. Talbert sent Renelle away to boarding school, while sinking deeper into his work of studying the strange substance of Remnant. When Renelle returned, she stole some of his money out of spite. Dr. Talbert, acting out of rage, kicked Renelle out of the house. It's unclear what happened to Renelle afterwards.

Dr. Talbert's studying of Remannt got the attention of Eleanor, an evil animatronic who enjoyed the suffering of others. She wanted Remnant for herself to become more powerful, and decides to exploit Dr. Talbert by pretending to be his lost daughter. Eleanor finds out about the family's falling out, and uses it to her advantage.
